title: Commit-gated embed+rerank smokebench and rollback automation
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Add a commit-gated smokebench that runs offline embedding + reranker checks on every model/config change candidate. The goal is a fast, deterministic suite that can flag regressions before changes reach canary, wire up automated rollback triggers in the CI/CD pipeline, and produce actionable diagnostics for triage. This ticket covers the test harness, baseline snapshot management, thresholds, CI integration, and an automated rollback/mitigation flow tied to the release pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Smokebench runs as a GitHub Actions job triggered by model/config PRs and completes within 12 minutes for typical change set.
Three core metrics are computed for each cohort: normalized recall@k (k=1,5), precision@k, and cosine-centroid drift. Each metric has a configured threshold that can fail the job.
Failures automatically post a triage comment on the PR with a link to the diagnostic artifacts and open ENG-rollback sub-issue when severity >= medium.
Artifacts (sample queries, top-k vectors, diff histograms) are uploaded to the infra artifact bucket and a console dashboard snapshot link is generated.
A rollback action is executable via a single click / GitHub workflow dispatch that reverts the candidate model/config and notifies release owners.
Tooling respects release pinning: if a tenant has pinned a model version, smokebench runs but cannot auto-rollback on their private rollout routes.
Runbook entries and owner handoff notes added to the Embed Quality Guards Confluence page.
implementation_notes: Create a compact offline dataset: 4 representative cohorts (search, chat-snippets, support tickets, product-descriptions) with 500 queries each sampled from traffic windows.
Use deterministic embedding pipeline with fixed tokenization, temperature=0 prompts for reranker to reduce noise in offline checks.
Compute per-query metrics and aggregate with bootstrapped 95% CI; apply a sliding baseline window so thresholds adapt to stable drift patterns.
Leverage existing evaluation runner library but add 'smoke' mode that limits examples and disables expensive explainers.
Add a lightweight drift quantifier: median cosine shift and KL divergence over top-10 score distributions between baseline and candidate.
Implement job as GH action matrix so we can parallelize cohorts and k values and keep wall time low.
Expose thresholds as repo-level config file (.redwood/smokebench.yaml) so PMs can tune per-project without code changes.
On failure, capture failure signature (metric, delta, top-affected query IDs) and attach to PR as JSON and human summary.
Build a small lambda to trigger the rollback workflow and enforce permissions checks against release owners and dedicated rollback service account.
telemetry_and_metrics: Metric: recall@1, recall@5, precision@1 computed per cohort; store both raw and normalized deltas to baseline.
Metric: median cosine-centroid shift per cohort with threshold default 0.03; configurable per cohort.
Metric: percentage of queries with top-1 change in reranker result (expected noise < 1.5%); alert when > 3.0%.
Instrument smokebench runtime, memory, and per-shard latency; fail CI if runtime > 12 minutes or memory spikes suggest OOM risk.
Emit structured event to ops topic: smokebench.run.{start,finish,fail} containing job id, commit sha, model id, and metrics summary.
Record historical results in the Embed Quality Guards dashboard with trend lines and ability to slice by release, cohort, and config flag.
runbook: If CI job fails with single-metric degradation below critical: Notify on #embed-quality Slack, create a triage card, assign to oncall dataquality engineer.
If multi-metric critical failure or drift large (cosine shift > 0.07) trigger automated rollback and page release owner; start incident channel.
If flaky failures observed (CI passes intermittently across N=3 runs) escalate to investigate nondeterminism in tokenization/seed; add noise budget in smokebench config.
Post-rollback: run reduced validation on previous pinned model to confirm behaviour and close rollback sub-issue with annotated diagnostics.
